storyIntro: Marshal Maegan mobilizes the vanguard against the first shadow rifts.
storyOutro: The grasslands are clear, but echoes lead deeper into the woods.

storyDialogue.speaker: Rex
storyDialogue.text: I hear wolves in the high brush.

storyDialogue.speaker: Maegan
storyDialogue.text: Defeat the alpha to seal the Solarian rift!

storyIntro: Sylvana leads the vanguard deeper into the giant primeval tree kingdom.
storyOutro: The corrupted boughs have been pruned. New paths unfold.

storyIntro: Commander Lumi and Boreas secure the glacier pass boundaries.
storyOutro: The blizzard calms as the pass gates are refortified.

storyDialogue.speaker: Boreas
storyDialogue.text: Defeat the Frozen Behemoth of the ridge!

storyIntro: Rogue hero Shadow tracks dark misty entities creeping across Silent Fenns.
storyOutro: Shadow pledges his blades and scouting networks to Crownspire's Marshal.

storyDialogue.speaker: Shadow
storyDialogue.text: Grave creepers hide in deep mist.

storyIntro: Demon and Pyrogarr lead Solarian forces directly into volcanic sulfur cracks.
storyOutro: Brimstone waves are sealed behind thick, heavy obsidian walls.

storyDialogue.speaker: Demon
storyDialogue.text: Keep foot soldiers away from lava grids.

storyIntro: Arch-Geomancer Myshla uncovers massive crystal giants inside deep rifts.
storyOutro: A secure path is carved, yielding infinite mineral resources.

storyDialogue.speaker: Myshla
storyDialogue.text: Shatter the gargantuan high granite giant!

storyIntro: Lorelai coordinates naval lines against marine drakes and sirens.
storyOutro: Harbor chains are rebuilt and coastal routes reopen.

storyIntro: Faith protects high stargazing relays from greedy goblin bands.
storyOutro: Cosmic relays are stable; astronomical formulas secured.

storyDialogue.speaker: Faith
storyDialogue.text: Defeat the rogue sky lord chief!

storyIntro: Mira Greenleaf tracks corrupted elemental forces rotting old roots.
storyOutro: Blighted boughs are fully purged and forest spirits calm down.

storyIntro: Commander Rex coordinates icy defense operations against frost wyrm raids.
storyOutro: The central frozen vaults are secure, preserving holy solar seeds.

storyDialogue.speaker: Rex
storyDialogue.text: Slay the gargantuan Glacial Frost Wyrm!

storyIntro: Lorelai sails deep waters to purge high tides of pirate ambush craft.
storyOutro: Ships anchor secure; safe mercantile trade pathways established.

storyIntro: Commander Volkan leads core miners down the deep sulfur pits.
storyOutro: Brimstone reservoirs are securely mined and locked away.

storyDialogue.speaker: Volkan
storyDialogue.text: Seal the molten sulfur giant king!

storyIntro: Commander Heaven evaluates vanguard recruits through holy selection tasks.
storyOutro: Selection complete; gold paladins stand ready under Sovereign command.

storyIntro: Shadow leads a secret medical legion to heal corrupted misty fens.
storyOutro: Blighted vapors dissipate; natural spring flows restored.

storyDialogue.speaker: Shadow
storyDialogue.text: Defeat the grand Fenn shadow spinner!

storyIntro: Commander Rex patrols towering peaks to secure nesting legendary dragons.
storyOutro: Brave alliance lines hold; nest territories fortified.

storyDialogue.speaker: Rex
storyDialogue.text: Subdue the ancient mountain behemoth wyrm!

storyIntro: Commander Volkan subdues corrupted furnace sparks inside central armories.
storyOutro: Furnace fires are safe; military master arms secure.

storyDialogue.speaker: Volkan
storyDialogue.text: Slay the gargantuan slag iron behemoth colossus!

storyIntro: Lorelai coordinates naval battle arrays against deep-lying ocean kraken spawns.
storyOutro: Marine trade pathways are secured; sailors sing tribute.

storyDialogue.speaker: Lorelai
storyDialogue.text: Exterminate the multi-tentacled deep water Monarch!

storyIntro: Faith defends ancient stardust monolith structures from void-energy drakes.
storyOutro: Monolith relics are fully sealed; magical cosmic shields online.

storyIntro: Marshal Maegan coordinates final battle groupings against the lich vanguard.
storyOutro: Gate coordinates are sealed; the ultimate confrontation path ready.

storyDialogue.speaker: Maegan
storyDialogue.text: Vanquish the colossal Elite Infernal Behemoth guardian!

storyIntro: All legendary heroes unite on the steps of the central Sovereign Crown Throne to seal the final planar rift.
storyOutro: Crownspire's magical dominion is eternally restored, and the Sovereign Crown glows forever.
